android.desc:
🧩 Designed for seniors or anyone who wants an easy-to-use smartphone experience. Say goodbye to confusing menus and tiny buttons!

Key Features:

✅ Large, Clear Interface:
 - Oversized icons and text for effortless visibility.
 - Simple grid layout with no clutter.

✅ Favorite Apps & Contacts on Home Screen:
 - Pin your most-used apps and loved one's contacts upfront.
 - Optional contacts access – only if you want it!

✅ Helpful Quick Actions:
 - SOS
 - Torch
 - Wi-Fi
 - Ring Modes

✅ Directly add web shortcuts to the home screen for commonly used websites.

✅ No Tech Skills Needed:
 - No hidden menus or jargon.
 - Set up once and enjoy stress-free smartphone use.

✅ Customisation:
 - Hide away unused apps, rename apps
 - Lock settings and home screen to allow only the favourite contacts and apps 
 - Change home grid size, icon size and text size
 - Light and dark theme
 - Notification dots
 - Battery percentage
 - Support calling to third party apps (Whatsapp, Telegram etc)
 - Third party widgets support
 - Work profile apps support

✅ 100% Private & Secure:
 - All your data (apps, contacts) stays on your device.
 - No ads and no accounts required.

Why Choose Senior Launcher?
🛡️ Trusted by Caregivers: Perfect for family members setting up a phone for elderly members or for someone who is not tech savvy.

Permission:
The app uses the Accessibility permission for the feature of "Lock Screen" quick action. It is a completely optional feature. While enabling the accessibility, a system warning regarding the privacy is shown. No personal data is being collected by the app using accessibility.

How to Start:
 - Download the app.
 - Choose your free trial or go premium with one time purchase.
 - Enjoy a smartphone that finally makes sense!

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built a simplified Android launcher for seniors

quotes.text:
Hello everyone,

I built this app for a family member, which allows me to set up a simple home screen with selected apps and optional contacts, while locking down everything else to avoid mistakenly changing anything.

Another reason for creating this app was that the existing launchers for seniors had confusing or not good UI for home screen.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.eldo.launcher

Would love to hear the feedback.
